changelog: Rebuilt for Jellyfin 12.4 (lsheardo-12.4 branch) from upstream Bonfire 2.0.0 (LTS: theme editor, Moonfin sign-in, home-network PIN skip, daily PIN limit, index.html patching removed), plus our fixes kept: a cross-household sign-out forgets its entry only after the device is signed out; device merges never touch a device another household lists. Proposal, not installed.
description: Adds multi-user profile switching to Jellyfin. A single account can have up to five isolated profiles — each with its own watch history, parental controls, and library access.
name: Bonfire
